_comment: Every component the Linux ZIP contains, with the license it is distributed under, its source and how it is linked (RES-DIST-011, ADR-000218). tools/release/package.py maps every bundled file to an entry (Debian source package, Python distribution, or file name), copies the license files and fails on a component that is missing or whose license is not in 'accepted'. Versions of distribution packages are read from dpkg at packaging time.
accepted: BSD-3-Clause AND GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 AND LGPL-2.1-or-later
